objective: Close the invocation crash window between reservation and external provider submission while preserving exact currentness and retry semantics.
observed: Self-hostile review found that a request could leave the process after RESERVED but before SUBMITTED was durably recorded, allowing recovery to replay an ambiguous generation.

The original ad-hoc cp-000006 omitted canonical checkpoint bookkeeping fields; the exact historical non-bookkeeping tool-call count is not reconstructable from repository state, so this recovery normalization records 0 and does not use it as evidence.
The R3.1 contract blob was 56a428ff12c665c7cd735f16c46daa92a538cc5a and architecture blob was d5470af547efe1487e8cd0f11925ccdc816a564b.
inferred: External submission needs a write-ahead durable intent record or recovery cannot distinguish unsent from ambiguously sent requests.
Semantic retry and transport retry require different evidence and generation-ID rules.
Pre-call currentness revalidation must be atomic with invocation reservation unless an exact lease covers the handoff.
completed: Added durable SUBMISSION_INTENT before external send.
Bound the exact request digest and any provider idempotency semantics before send.
Defined ambiguous recovery after SUBMISSION_INTENT as OUTCOME_UNKNOWN rather than RESERVED.
Allowed same-generation transport retry only under exact provider idempotency guarantees with unchanged request digest and idempotency key.
Required a new generation ID plus retry_of_generation_id for a new semantic retry after proved terminal failure.
Defined ATOMIC_START_SNAPSHOT and LEASE_THROUGH_SUBMISSION currentness semantics.
unfinished: Obtain exact-head hostile review of R3.1.
Close any demonstrated state-to-instruction laundering path across pre-projection stages.
Define executable contract regressions and restore repository-level WIP validation to green.
next_action: Hold R3.1 stable for hostile review; if a demonstrated defect appears, repair it in a new successor and re-run exact-head validation.
do_not_repeat: Do not resend an OUTCOME_UNKNOWN semantic invocation without reconciliation.
Do not use provider idempotency assumptions that are not explicitly guaranteed by the exact provider contract.
Do not treat projection success as proof of currentness at invocation time.
Do not merge, deploy, install, or claim behavioral qualification.
